text: - Define shared constants and domain types in `core/constants/` as union types (not `enum` — the client has `erasableSyntaxOnly` enabled). Use `as const` objects when runtime access is needed (e.g. `Role`), and plain union types when only type checking is needed (e.g. `type TicketStatus = "open" | "resolved" | "closed"`).
